I heard that the royal family of Camaroar used to offer rings to my ancestors. Ha, those things must've been humongous.
My name's Ignacarious Gigantareno Rex Le Spes Offerentis, but my human friend named me ▢▢▢.
Here he is! The most splendiferous prize of ! Me!
My wings flap, my sneezes are flame-nados, and my super fire beam breaths are only getting stronger! No more getting treated like a hatchling!

Sona.pick: What masterpiece shall we play today?
more: Haha. I can never shake the nerves before a big performance.
I never could refuse an empty stage. Not even this one.
Curtains up. I'm ready.
A wrong note is just...a happy little accident.
The storm of conflict between the gods has raged for far too long. I will be the light that pierces the clouds.
I bring the light to burn away the falsehoods of chaos.
Awaken! Hope and order!
This is my path.

Swain.pick: Fear the power you do not see.
Swain.ban: Do not confuse cowardice for wisdom.
more: You can sit on a throne, that doesn't make you a ruler. It only means you have an arse.
I have seen this place... A vision... A battle.
The outcome was decided when they brought an army; and I brought a demon.
If they already call me a villain, what will they call me when I succeed?

Sylas.ban: You can't cage me for long.
more: So... who wants to kill the king?
The great mage rebellion starts now!
See the remnants of my bondage, and know you can be free!
Breaking out was nothing! Watch me break a kingdom.

Syndra.ban: People fear what they cannot understand.
more: My potential is limitless!
By force of will.
Easily.
Let them try to stop me.

TahmKench.pick: Call me king, call me demon. Water forgets the names of the drowned.
TahmKench.ban: You're duller than a broken sandwich.
more: Let us peruse this establishment's fare.
It is the heart from which the darkest water flows.
This buffet exceeds repugnance!
It is my mouth into which all travels end.

Taliyah.pick: Know the loom. Be the stone.
more: The ground here conceals a mighty power.
Every tapestry begins with a single stitch.
Time to apply what I've learned.
Time to roll up my sleeves.

Talon.pick: Live and die by the blade.
more: They won't survive.
Only fools pledge life to honor.
On the razor's edge.
I never compromise.

Taric.pick: That glimmer of hope you see, that's me.
Taric.ban: Your judgement is clouded. Seek clarity.
more: There is great power in the stars. Great danger as well.
Crash the mountain upon them.
The most precious jewel is the one we hold in our heart.
There's nowhere left to go but up.
Survive here a week, then you get a name.
There's a mushroom out there with your name on it.
The war never ends, the battlefield just changes.
Survival ain't pretty.

Thresh.pick: What delightful agony we shall inflict.
more: No weapon in any reality can harm us.
Stars cold of life. Silent in the darkness.
I will guide them beyond the brink of infinity.
Torment comes in so many flavors.

Tristana.pick: Once a Bandle gunner, always a Bandle gunner!
more: I call frontline.
I bravely volunteer to charge in recklessly!
Locked, loaded, and ready to rocket!
Walking tall.
I'm troll judge, troll jury, and execu... troll!
The Freljord is mine!
King of trolls, coming through.
I'm the troll with the plan.
No salvation.
There is no going back.
Soon all will join me.
Must... go.
Charmed, I'm sure.
Doin' it.
I'm one of a kind.
It's my lucky day.

Twitch.pick: What doesn't kill you just isn't finished yet.
more: Hey, what did I step in?
From out of the sewers comes... doom.
Who let all these plants survive?
Ohoho, yes, yes...
The spirits at the heart of the Freljord have need of me. I answer their call.
Hear me, spirits. I pray for struggle. I pray for growth.
I can taste our enemies' hunger for victory. Let them starve.
For many years I thought I was cursed. I still wonder.

Urgot.pick: You cannot know strength... Until you are broken.
Urgot.ban: Cling to hope... It is all you have.
more: If they could only comprehend the truth of the Dredge... I wouldn't need to drive it into their skulls.
Enjoy this final moment... before your trial begins.
It is time... for them to die.
Controlling them will be simple... with my hand around their throats.

Varus.ban: I have no grace to give.
more: No mercy, no forgiveness. Mortal or monster, all will fall.
Every step forward...
...is stolen.
I move toward the vengeance I deserve.

Vayne.pick: Let us hunt those who have fallen to darkness.
more: Hunting directive: active.
Delete the past. I am the future.
Only one protocol remains: the hunt.
The hunt is the same, only the weapons have changed.

Veigar.pick: Know that if the tables were turned, I would show you no mercy!
more: My every victory symbolizes the crumbling of justice!
Unimaginable is the power of ▢▢▢!
Welcome to your doom!
Champions! Welcome to die!
My presence causes them... distress.
A land rich with information...
What else can I discover?
The light here is harsh.
And then I told her, 'Get outta my room!' And she said, 'This is my house, young lady and'... Oh, hang on, Shadow. I'll finish this later.
Blegh, just got here: already over it.
Other people are here? Ugggh, great.
This is going to be... awful, in a very good way. A good, awful way. You know what I mean!

Vi.pick: Punch first. Ask questions while punching.
Vi.ban: If I want your opinion, I'll beat it out of you.
more: Here I come to save the day... or wreck it.
I'm doing this my way.
I let my hands do the talking.
Piltover's finest.
She waits for me beyond the mist. My queen. My love. My black and broken heart.
No price is too great. No atrocity beyond my reach. For her, I will do anything.
Submission or death for all who live. In the end, it matters not. I will see her face again.
It hurts, my heart. It hurts so much.
Function over form.
All will soon change.
Metal is perfection.
Embrace progress.
Wonderful.
My cup is half empty.
The clot thickens.
Please, let it all out.

Volibear.pick: Feel the power of the wild.
Volibear.ban: You have the heart of a weakling.
more: The land will exist far longer than warm-bloods.
The land belongs to the wild. Today, we reclaim it with tooth and claw.
Their bones are ash and soil. Mine rumble with wild thunder.
Follow me and we will bring down sky!
The chains are broken... the beast is free.
The blood you spilled calls to me.
Oh, what a day. What a bloody day.
Violence supercharged!

Xayah.pick: I can never resist an invitation to dance.
Xayah.ban: Fine, I'll just be over here... sharpening my feathers.
more: Let's cut 'em to ribbons.
Ah, silence, so golden. Like Rakan. Kind of miss him. Even if he is... noisy.
The vastaya named the world. We named the trees, the wind, the mountains. We know their power.
If love is feeling so deeply for another that you want to chew your way under their skin, then I love Rakan...
The world may crumble, but I shall remain.
I am eternal.
I will show you true power.
I will be their undoing.

XinZhao.ban: The warrior's spirit is never broken.
more: My king commands.
It shall be done!
To triumph!
A Demacian does not retreat.

Yasuo.pick: Death is like the wind—always by my side.
more: Whispers on the wind speak of a masked swordsman with two blades.
My brother returned. Seems dying was the easy part.
This story is not yet finished.
Justice. That's a pretty word.

Yone.pick: One to cut, one to seal.
Yone.ban: You think I am the one to fear? Hmph.
more: Before, I chased a wayward gale. Now I hunt a storm of darkness.
Many mistake me for the nightmares I slay. Hmph, let them.
In this cursed second life, where does the mask end, and I begin?
They look at me and see only the mask.

Yorick.pick: Fear not... I will make use of your corpse.
more: I once had honor... before the Ruination.
This land will never heal. But I will lay it to rest.
Tired, ancient, and half-dead. Still, I come for you.
I am the rift between life and death. The thin divide between breath and grave.

Yuumi.pick: You and me, we got this!
Yuumi.ban: More of a dog person, huh?
more: Cats make great companions! Just ask my master... who disappeared under mysterious circumstances.
Alright! Which one of you's got great aim, and is good at chin scritches?
Who's ready to risk our lives, defeat our foes, and maybe knock over some cups?
Tell me the game plan again. Wait. Fish! Someone has fish! Where is it?

Zac.pick: I was made for this... literally.
more: I should get a suit.
Let's bounce!
I may bend, but I don't break.
Just another day on the job.

Zed.pick: The unseen blade is the deadliest.
more: We are life, perfected.
What we have seen... what we have done... you are all part of it.
We will cure the galaxy of conflict. We will cure the galaxy of ignorance.
We once bowed before the Templars. Now, we are the truth they deny.

Zeri.pick: A spark is all I need!
more: You know what? We might die here. Let's make sure we go down swinging.
Yell if you need backup. I'll be there in no time.
Zaun's with me every fight. This time's no different.
Sweet, we're here. Whoa, crazy weapons! This team's great. Let's go!
Right-o!
Anyone got a... match?
Come on... come on, come on!
Let's blow this joint.

Zilean.pick: I knew you would do that...

more: There are holes in reality. And... in donuts.
When the beings here look up, do they think we're looking back?! We really aren't.
♪ Here we go on an adventure, through this place! Even though we don't know the name of it! ♪ It doesn't matter!
There are so many weirdos here... It's awesome!
Come closer.
Such a busy world.
Just a harmless flower.
Take careful steps.
